rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Ontology identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Term or code used to identify something or someone registered within a particular ontology.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Word or phrase that constitutes the distinctive designation of a being or thing.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Species
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Category of biological classification comprising related organisms or populations potentially capable of interbreeding, and being designated by a binomial that consists of the name of a genus followed by a Latin or latinized uncapitalized noun or adjective.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Digital identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Digital handle to identify objects or legal persons.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Description
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Longer statement or account giving the characteristics of someone or something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Synonym
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Words or expressions used in the same language that have the same or nearly the same meaning in some or all senses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Phenotype
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Physical expression of one or more genes of an organism.
